pull_request.title: feat: implement collection_len_in_loop_condition lint (#115)
pull_request.body:
## Summary

Adds a new lint that detects \.len()\ calls on Soroban collection types (\Vec\, \Map\, \Set\) inside loops when the collection is not mutated within the loop body.

On Soroban host-side collections, \.len()\ is a metered host call — it crosses the contract–host boundary and incurs CPU cost each time. When the collection is not modified, re-evaluating the length every iteration wastes one host call per iteration for a value that never changes.

## Changes

- **\soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs\** — \CollectionLenInLoopCondition\ lint pass with type checking, mutation detection, and loop enclosure check
- **\soroban_cost_lints/ui/main.rs\** — Extended stub with Vec/Map/Set; 4 flagged, 4 non-flagged, 1 \#[allow]\ case
- **\docs/lints/collection_len_in_loop_condition.md\** — Reference page
- **\docs/lints/README.md\** — Table row
- **\docs/SUMMARY.md\** — TOC entry
- **\CHANGELOG.md\** — [Unreleased] entry

## Mutation detection

Conservative — only detects direct method calls on the same local variable with mutation names (\push\, \pop\, \insert\, \set\, \emove\, \clear\, \	runcate\, \swap_remove\). Indirect mutations are not detected (documented as known limitation).

## Requires local verification

No Rust toolchain available. Must run before merge:

\\\ ash
cargo fmt --all
BLESS=1 cargo test --workspace
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
\\\

Closes #115
